address: Avenida da República 171, Vila Real de Santo António, 8900-203, Portugal
bio: A restaurant occupying one of the most emblematic buildings in town within the walls of the Grand House hotel, where you can enjoy a delightful view of the port of Vila Real de Santo António and the banks of the Guadiana river that acts as a border between Portugal and Spain. Here, a meal is akin to delving deeply into the sophisticated ambience of another era. The decor has been thoughtfully designed, with wicker tables and decorative detail in which wood is the primary resource. The cuisine here is based around ingredients from the Algarve and is showcased on a concise menu that values freshness, seasonality and minimum waste. As a fitting end to this unique experience, enjoy a classic cocktail in the elegant Grand Salon Bar, with its old-style service....
